verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents rule-driven automation for incident events. Escalation policies are a "custom set of rules for incident alerting" that can depend on time, team availability and incident origin. Incident handling can automatically post a todo list and route the incident when it triggers, and monitors automatically create incidents and alert on-call. The action set shown is limited to alerting, escalation and routing rather than general event-to-action automation, and the AI SRE explicitly takes no automated actions without approval. Missing for 10: arbitrary or custom actions (e.g., outbound webhooks or scripted remediation) triggered by rules, detailed docs on the incident workflow rule builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
